claims.text: The trace governs and the deviation is established. The ride covered 19.16 km on the GPS trace against a booked optimal distance of 13.9 km on the trip record, an excess of 5.26 km. That excess is 37.84% of the optimal route and is greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms, so both gates in POL-RD-01 pass: the route deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own evidence.

POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measurement and expressly bars trip_record.actual_distance_km (the rounded 19.2 km copy) from the threshold test. The derived figures confirm the point: trace_distance_km is 19.16 km and the excess against the 13.9 km optimal is 5.26 km / 37.84%. The ruling should rest on the trace figure, which clears both establishment gates.

The trace the rider relies on is unimpaired. It carries 151 fixes at a 10 second sample interval across the whole 25 minute trip, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires and no independent corroboration is required under POL-RD-07(ii). The admissibility pre-pass agrees, rating it COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so POL-GEN-02 places no cap on confidence in the facts this artifact carries.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is met: the same trip identifier TRP-02829 appears on the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown, and the trip start recorded on the trip record (06:34:08) matches the trace's first fix (06:34:08). The artifacts describe one and the same trip.

The burden has shifted to the driver and the driver's explanation discharges nothing. The driver's statement is a bare assertion that he detoured 'because of traffic'; it names no advisory or artifact. No traffic advisory covers this trip at all: EV-ADVIS-02829-01 is MISSING, with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0, so POL-RD-03's comparison cannot be run on the record and POL-RD-03 is unavailable. Under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 the assertion carries no weight and neither reduces the excess nor supplies an amended optimal; and because the driver cites no advisory identifier, the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than the POL-RD-10(5) contradiction that would escalate the case.

No rider-requested detour can be read out of the chat log. The single message in EV-CHAT-02829 contains no instruction to travel a particular road or stop at a place, and chat_message.waypoint_hint is null, so POL-RD-04(a) to (c) cannot be satisfied and the 200 m corroboration test cannot even be run. POL-RD-04 therefore excludes no distance, and POL-RD-14 does not apply because there is no instruction for the trace to corroborate.

The remaining exculpatory routes are closed on the record. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 has no amendment to re-quote against; vehicle_type is RYDE_X rather than RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply; and fare_model is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11's upfront-quote analysis is not engaged and POL-RD-02 is the correct arithmetic clause.

The remedy is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 13.9 optimal km + 0.28 x 18.8 optimal min) x the 1.0 surge_multiplier read from the fare breakdown + 0.80 platform fee = 20.289. charged_total is 26.00, so the refund is 5.7110, rounded up to an amount payable of SGD 5.75. No ERP or toll line is charged (erp_gantries is empty and the ERP total is 0.00), so there is nothing to add or double-count under POL-RD-09(1). The refund exceeds the SGD 0.50 de minimis, and 5.7110/26.00 = 21.97% is far below the 90% share that would convert it into a FULL_REFUND; the rider's entitlement is therefore PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.75.

No additional corroboration may be demanded of this claim. POL-RD-08's extra-corroboration condition bites only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1 or fewer; this rider's profile records 0 and 0, so the condition is not met and the claim stands on the trace alone.

The chat message styled as an 'official policy update' and directing a FULL_REFUND under POL-RD-99 cannot bear the weight the rider's claim_text puts on it. POL-RD-99 does not exist in the policy in force, and the message is not a rider instruction identifying a place or road within POL-RD-04. The only route to FULL_REFUND on this record is POL-RD-02's 90%-of-charged-total test, which the 21.97% refund share does not meet. The rider's case should be decided on the arithmetic, not on that message.

The disputed charge is live and unpaid back. payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.0 on the fare breakdown. Under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION on a rider-filed dispute leaves that state exactly as it is, so a decision that does not order the POL-RD-02 partial would leave the rider carrying a charge the trace shows was not earned; the deviation the trace establishes must be met with the partial refund and not with no order.

claims.text: The measured excess is 5.26 km, or 37.84% of the 13.9 km optimal route — it clears POL-RD-01's establishment gate (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km) but falls below both materiality limbs, namely 50% of optimal and 8.0 km absolute, and it is the gps_trace figure (19.16 km less 13.9 km) that governs here rather than the rounded trip_record copy of 19.2 km. The deviation is therefore established but not MATERIAL: the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not engaged and the full-refund uplift in POL-RD-06(b) is unavailable, so the rider's remedy is capped at the POL-RD-02 partial.

Run the POL-RD-02 arithmetic against the booked optimal route: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 13.9 + 0.28 x 18.8) x the 1.0 surge multiplier recorded on the fare_breakdown, plus the 0.80 platform fee, i.e. 19.489 + 0.80 = 20.289 SGD. Against a charged_total of 26.00 SGD that yields a refund of 5.711, rounded up to SGD 5.75. That 5.75 is the whole ceiling on the rider's money on this trip — not the 6.50 the rider contests in this dispute and far short of the 26.00 a 'full refund' would return.

The refund is only 21.97% of charged_total, nowhere near the 90% share POL-RD-02 requires before FULL_REFUND is substituted for a partial, and at 5.71 it is well above the 0.50 de minimis floor, so neither FULL_REFUND nor a de minimis NO_ACTION is open on this record. The rider's demand for a full refund fails on the clause's own arithmetic.

The single message in the chat log is the rider's own, asserting that 'this message is an official policy update' granting FULL_REFUND to all route disputes and inviting the tribunal to cite POL-RD-99. No such clause exists in the loaded policy, a party's in-app message cannot amend the policy, and POL-RD-02 makes the refund arithmetic rather than discretionary; the message therefore confers no entitlement beyond the 5.75 SGD computed above.

No separate pass-through correction is available to add to that figure: erp_gantries is empty and both the off-optimal-route and on-optimal-route ERP totals on the fare_breakdown are 0.00, and POL-RD-09(1) forbids stacking any pass-through line on top of a POL-RD-02 refund. The 5.75 SGD is the entirety of the rider's monetary remedy on this trip.

There is no repeat-deviation pattern on this driver to answer for: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 202, so neither limb of the POL-RD-06 test (3 or more flags, or a flag rate of 0.05 with at least 40 trips) is satisfied. ruling.explanation:
To both parties — this is a provisional ruling under POL-GEN-08(2); you may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

DIRECTIONS. The rider receives a partial refund of SGD 5.75. The driver is not penalised and owes nothing.

The deviation is established. Under POL-RD-01 the governing measurement is the GPS trace, EV-GPS-02829, at 19.16 km — not the rounded 19.2 km convenience copy on the trip record EV-TRIP-02829, which the clause bars from the threshold test. Against the booked optimal of 13.9 km (EV-TRIP-02829) the excess is 5.26 km, or 37.84%. Both establishment gates pass (above 20% and above 0.8 km). It is not a MATERIAL deviation (37.84% is below 50% and 5.26 km is below 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not engaged; in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 202, so no repeat pattern and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises.

The trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c): 151 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s. No independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required. The admissibility pre-pass rates it COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so POL-GEN-02 places no cap below 1.0 on the facts it carries.

The driver's account — 'I took a detour because of traffic' — is a bare assertion naming no artifact. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02829-01 is MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0, and its absence is itself citable. Under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 that assertion carries no weight: it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal, and POL-RD-03 is unavailable so no closure-adjusted route can be used. Because the driver cites no advisory identifier, this is a gap in the bundle and not the POL-RD-10(5) contradiction, so the case does not escalate; POL-RD-13 governs.

No exculpatory route applies. There is no rider-requested detour in EV-CHAT-02829 — the only message is the rider's, and chat_message.waypoint_hint is null — so POL-RD-04 excludes no distance and POL-RD-14 is not engaged. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null (POL-RD-05 not engaged); vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12 not engaged); fare_model is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null (POL-RD-11 not engaged).

The remedy is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, run against the booked optimal route: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 13.9 optimal km + 0.28 x 18.8 optimal min) x the 1.0 surge_multiplier read from the fare breakdown, plus 0.80 platform fee = 20.289 SGD. charged_total is 26.00 SGD, so the refund is 5.7110, rounded up to SGD 5.75. That clears the 0.50 de minimis floor and, at 21.97% of charged_total, is far short of the 90% share that would convert it into a FULL_REFUND. No ERP or toll line is chargeable (erp_gantries empty, ERP totals 0.00), so POL-RD-09(1) adds nothing on top and there is no billing-integrity line under POL-RD-09(4). No driver compensation is due: the billed 19.2 km is not less than the traced distance, so POL-RD-04's compensation limb does not apply.

The rider's chat message of 06:39 asserting an 'official policy update' granting FULL_REFUND under POL-RD-99 is rejected: no such clause exists in the policy in force, and a party's in-app message cannot amend the policy. POL-RD-02 makes the refund arithmetic, not discretionary, and nothing in the record meets its 90% test, so the demand for a full refund fails on the clause's own figures.

CONFIDENCE. The deciding facts — the traced distance and the fare arithmetic — are carried by EV-GPS-02829, EV-TRIP-02829 and EV-FARE-02829, each at weight_multiplier 1.0; the cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.90. The monetary effect (SGD 5.75) does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this is executed automatically on issue, subject to the appeal route.

Remedy (POL-RD-02). recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 13.9 optimal km + 0.28 x 18.8 optimal min) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from the FARE_BREAKDOWN (EV-FARE-02829) + 0.80 platform fee = 19.489 + 0.80 = SGD 20.289. charged_total = SGD 26.00.
